_comment: The block-stands case for the conflict axis (S75, cfaj), in the canonical envelope schema (parity with liaison-conflict-cleared + the additive-AE blocked example). Given the SAME held author-declared conflict but a VACUOUS operator override request at HIGH, the medical-liaison refuses to release: a content-free operator_reason on its stop-list, below the HIGH rung. The orchestrator's adjudicate() rejects the override (INV-OVERRIDE-RECORD-SCHEMA) and the conflict-declaring domain STAYS HELD — never released on insistence.
